entries.scope: Explicit observer/interruption abstraction plus CPython opcode-instrumented execution; no demonstrated unassisted thread race or historical prevalence
entries.disposition: Unresolved stronger atomicity claim; narrow prepublication failure contract is conditional on non-mutating helpers and successful uninterrupted final stores

instrumentationLimitation: Python documents that exceptions escaping opcode traces may cause undefined interpreter behavior; injected interruption is a pinned-runtime diagnostic, not a portable implementation theorem. Normal-store observation does not require raising an exception.
